description: Full intro for one app: summary, supported languages, website and about page (null when there is none), a contact page (contactUrl, only where one exists), status, and dataTools — the tools on this server that return that app's public data. NodajiMarket is the exception: its products and checkout live on a separate MCP server (mcpServer: "nodajimarket", listed in this server's /.well-known/mcp.json).
